consequence.statement: Reverts a CI e2e kind-log export step; no operational consequence for operators is stated.

original.statement: A CI-only change reverts exporting kind logs on e2e failure; it has no operator-facing effect.

decision.reason: [ev-f42cb542e4b7] lists only a revert of the "ci(e2es): export kind logs on failure" commit. The ci(e2es) scope places this in the project's own end-to-end CI tests, which export kind cluster logs when a test fails. Nothing in the evidence touches the shipped product surface or says that any operator-facing behavior changes. So the consequence is "none" and the change is informational only.
